artifacts.summary: 23 READMEs wrapped in generated-inventory markers, escape-aware split_row, 164 descriptions preserved, INV coverage demonstrated, three-tier sweep report.

completion_data.completion_summary: Made split_row in scripts/check-module-invariants.sh escape-aware and wrapped the RaySummary and KTypeSummary inventory tables plus 21 further clean-fit tables under FormalSystem/ in BEGIN GENERATED markers; all 164 hand-written descriptions survived regeneration byte-for-byte, 108 stale counts were refreshed by the generator, and INV was shown to fail on a corrupted count in each of the 23 new blocks. Tier B/C tables are reported in the summary, not patched.

memory_candidates.content: To opt a README inventory table into check-module-invariants.sh INV coverage: wrap it in <!-- BEGIN GENERATED: inventory dir=<repo-relative dir> --> / <!-- END GENERATED --> and run --emit-inventory. The generator keeps the header line verbatim (so | File | Lines | Role | fits without a rewrite), re-keys descriptions by file name, alphabetizes rows, adds thousands separators, and adds TODO rows for undescribed live files. Verify preservation with a key-sorted before/after description diff; an inline | in a description must be written \| (split_row is escape-aware).

git-snapshot.sh --no-revert writes untracked-backup-<ts>/ (copies of ALL untracked files, including other tasks' in-flight specs dirs) and working-progress-<ts>.patch inside the current task directory; git-commit-phase.sh's task-directory pathspec then commits them. Only snapshot when a destructive git command actually follows, and git rm the backup before the next phase commit if one was taken.
